gloss: preheating; warming up (an oven, an engine, etc.) in advance

definitions.gloss: the act of heating an oven, machine, or engine in advance to a desired temperature before use; preheating
definitions.explanation: Refers to warming something up to its working temperature before the actual operation begins. The most familiar use is for ovens in baking and cooking — Japanese recipes typically include the instruction オーブンを 200 {度|ど}に{予熱|よねつ}しておく ('preheat the oven to 200°C'). The word also covers preheating in industrial contexts (engines, kilns, manufacturing equipment) and figuratively in expressions about warming up the body before exercise. Used as a noun and as a する-verb ({予熱|よねつ}する 'to preheat').

examples.japanese: ⟦オーブン→オーブン：04674_oobun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{予熱|よねつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
{予熱|よねつ}⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦お{皿|さら}→お皿：02894_osara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{用意|ようい}して→用意する：22428_youisuru⟧おこう。
examples.english: Let me get the dishes ready while it preheats.

examples.japanese: ⟦オーブン→オーブン：04674_oobun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ 180 ⟦{度|ど}→〜度：09845_do⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{予熱|よねつ}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦ケーキ→ケーキ：01356_keeki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生地|きじ}→生地：02631_kiji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れます→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: First preheat the oven to 180°C, then put the cake batter in.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{特|とく}に→特に：01260_tokuni⟧、⟦エンジン→エンジン：03835_enjin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始動|しどう}して→始動する：19361_shidousuru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{数分間|すうふんかん}{予熱|よねつ}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{走|はし}り{出|だ}した→走り出す：06679_hashiridasu⟧⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: Especially in winter, it's better to start the engine and let it warm up for a few minutes before driving off.

notes:
Composed of {予|よ} ('in advance, beforehand') + ⟦{熱|ねつ}→熱：01690_netsu⟧ ('heat'). Literally 'heating in advance'. The {予|よ} prefix is highly productive: ⟦{予習|よしゅう}→予習：01748_yoshuu⟧ ('preparatory study'), ⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧ ('reservation'), ⟦{予防|よぼう}→予防：03669_yobou⟧ ('prevention'), ⟦{予告|よこく}→予告：08379_yokoku⟧ ('advance notice').

USAGE:
{予熱|よねつ} is used most often about ovens in cooking and baking. Recipes routinely begin with the instruction:
- ⟦オーブン→オーブン：04674_oobun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ 180⟦{度|ど}→〜度：09845_do⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{予熱|よねつ}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧おく ('preheat the oven to 180°C in advance')

The word is also used about warming up engines (especially diesel engines and old cars) and about machinery that needs to reach an operating temperature before it can function properly.

IMPORTANT — ホモフォン:
The homophone ⟦{余熱|よねつ}→余熱：17769_yonetsu⟧ (residual heat) is the *opposite* concept: it refers to the heat that remains after the heat source has been turned off — for example, the residual heat of a frying pan or oven that can finish cooking food. Be careful to distinguish:
- {予熱|よねつ}: preheating, advance heating
- ⟦{余熱|よねつ}→余熱：17769_yonetsu⟧: residual heat, leftover heat
In Japanese cookbooks and cooking shows, {予熱|よねつ} instructions are essentially universal. Many home oven models (especially ⟦{電子|でんし}→電子：03449_denshi⟧⟦オーブンレンジ→オーブンレンジ：22706_oobunrenji⟧ combo units) include a dedicated {予熱|よねつ} button that beeps when the chosen temperature is reached.

COMMON PATTERNS:
Used as a plain noun and as a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧-verb. In its verbal form {予熱|よねつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ the object can be the device being preheated (⟦オーブン→オーブン：04674_oobun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{予熱|よねつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧) or omitted when context is clear. The form {予熱|よねつ}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧おく ('preheat in advance, leave preheated') is the most natural in recipes.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦オーブン→オーブン：04674_oobun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{予熱|よねつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to preheat the oven
- {予熱|よねつ}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧おく: to preheat in advance
- {予熱|よねつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{完了|かんりょう}する→完了する：20676_kanryousuru⟧: for preheating to be complete
- {予熱|よねつ}⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧: while preheating
- {予熱|よねつ}⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧: preheating time
- {予熱|よねつ}⟦{機能|きのう}→機能：13165_kinou⟧: preheating function (on an oven or device)
- ⟦エンジン→エンジン：03835_enjin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{予熱|よねつ}: warming up the engine
- 200 ⟦{度|ど}→〜度：09845_do⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{予熱|よねつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to preheat to 200°C

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{余熱|よねつ}→余熱：17769_yonetsu⟧: residual heat — homophone with the *opposite* meaning. Used about cooking food in residual heat after the oven is turned off (⟦{余熱|よねつ}→余熱：17769_yonetsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{火|ひ}→火：02248_hi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|とお}す→通す：02300_toosu⟧).
- ⟦{温|あたた}める→温める：02096_atatameru⟧: to warm up — the everyday spoken verb; broader and applies to anything that gets warmed.
- ⟦{加熱|かねつ}→加熱：00168_kanetsu⟧: heating, application of heat — the general scientific/technical word.
- ウォーム⟦アップ→アップ：00005_appu⟧: warm-up — used about exercise and engines; less specific than {予熱|よねつ}.
- {暖機|だんき}: warm-up of an engine — a more technical motoring term, particularly common with the verb {暖機|だんき}⟦{運転|うんてん}→運転：01335_unten⟧.
